description: LLM detector conformance. For each case, run the detector with the given prompt id on `text` (one chunk) with a scripted model that returns modelOutput. 'masks' are rule hits (candidates) to hide in a detect.v2 prompt; they are ignored for detect.v1. 'expect' is [text, category, confidence, roleHint] for every candidate, ordered by span. 'generals' is the detector report's category:lowercased-text -> phrase map. promptIncludes/promptExcludes are substrings of the rendered prompt. 'hallucinated' is the dropped-item count.

cases.name: v2 lines: people, org and place with general phrases
cases.text: Hi Raj, I work at Mercy General Hospital near Elm Street. Thanks, Maya
cases.modelOutput:
PERSON | Raj | landlord | -
ORG | Mercy General Hospital | employer | a large hospital
LOCATION | Elm Street | nearby street | a nearby street
PERSON | Maya | me | -
END
promptIncludes:
Hi Raj, I work at Mercy General Hospital near Elm Street. Thanks, Maya
>>>

cases.name: v2: ? means low confidence, - means none, bullets and prose lines are tolerated
cases.text: Dr Wu saw me about my knee.
cases.modelOutput:
Here you go:
- ?PERSON | Dr Wu | doctor | -
? HEALTH | knee | - | -
END
Hope that helps

cases.name: v2: a bare END is a valid empty answer
v2: rule hits are masked in the prompt and an echoed mask is ignored
cases.text: Hi Raj, mail me at maya@example.com or call 312-555-0147. I work at Mercy General Hospital.
cases.modelOutput:
PERSON | Raj | friend | -
CONTACT | [email] | - | -
CONTACT | [phone] | - | -
ORG | Mercy General Hospital | employer | a hospital
END
promptIncludes: mail me at [email] or call [phone]. I work at

cases.name: v2: invented text is dropped and counted; a general is kept only for org, location and health

cases.modelOutput:
PERSON | Zed | friend | -
PERSON | Raj | landlord | a tall man
END
